messages:
Maria H: FYI I rolled the new continuous-batcher tuning to the small-cohort canary last night — seeing intermittent tail blips this morning.
perf-bot: deploy: continuous-batcher-tune -> canary (10%) at 2026-03-18T06:58:00Z
Simon T: What magnitude and when?
Maria H: p95 +50-70ms, p99 up ~250-420ms in two transient spikes around 07:12 and 09:03 UTC. No errors, throughput similar.
Lee R: Did the deploy touch kernel routing code? I thought it was only batch/token_budget changes.
Maria H: No kernel binary changes. But kernel-selection logs show a run of requests that would have hit fast_small ended up on compat_generic during the spike windows.
Ana P: Do we have batch-shape histograms and selector decisions from those nodes?
Maria H: Uploaded a quick dump: s3://redwood-debug/perf/canary/1760849999/selector_dump.log and batch_shapes.csv
perf-bot: alert: canary p99 > baseline by 200ms at 2026-03-18T07:15:10Z
Lee R: Quick grep: reason codes = KERNEL_MISROUTE(23) spiked with selector_confidence drop around 07:11:55.
Maria H: Also noticed KV prefix hit-rate for the cohort dropped from ~80% to ~38% right before the first blip.
Ana P: That could change effective seq-lengths if prefix not cached — selector input depends on expected shape, right?
Lee R: Selector takes batch shape, prefetched_kv boolean (smoothed), and a shaped latency prior. Smoothing window is 10s currently.
Simon T: If the batching tweak lowers token_budget targets, we may be packing more aggressively. With normal kv-hit high, that was good. But a sudden kv miss burst changes workload and the smoothed selector lags.
Maria H: Example trace id=t-9b7e:
```
request: prompt ~50 tokens
batch formation: 3 requests -> shape 3x50 at +3ms
kv lookup: miss on prefix P-9b -> full context fetch
selector: evaluated on smoothed priors -> picked compat_generic
exec: +320ms vs fast_small ~+40ms
```
Ana P: So flow: budget tweak -> denser pack policy -> when kv misses happen, the runtime sequence and execution path change, and smoothing prevents selector from flipping to the correct kernel quickly.
Simon T: Can we make selector react to immediate kv-miss signal rather than only smoothed stats?
Lee R: We already log kv_hit per-request; selector ignores the immediate boolean and relies on averaged feature currently. Easiest change: feed kv_hit as an instant override/bias.
Maria H: I tested locally: exposing kv_hit immediate to selector and reducing smoothing to 3s on a node reduced misroutes in a synthetic burst.
perf-bot: deploy-start: continuous-batcher-hotfix/kv-immediate to canary
Ana P: Two things to consider: (A) short-term mitigation for stability, (B) follow-on retrain or selector redesign for bursty miss patterns.
Simon T: For short-term, do hotfix: add kv_hit immediate bias + tune smoothing to 3s for small cohort. Risk low and keeps batch optimization benefits.
Lee R: Agreed. If hotfix doesn't stabilize by EOD, we revert the budget tweak.
Maria H: I'll push hotfix to canary and add a cohort-level alert for KV hit-rate drops.
perf-bot: deploy-success: continuous-batcher-hotfix/kv-immediate applied to canary at 2026-03-18T08:10:22Z
Simon T: After the hotfix, what do metrics show?
Maria H: Initial read: p95 back to baseline (~-40ms vs spike), p99 down ~220ms (still slightly above baseline but much improved). KV hit-rate rebounded to ~76% as prefetch/priming happened during rollout.
Ana P: Good. File a ticket to retrain selector or adjust feature set to include ephemeral signals like kv_miss bursts and batch-formation deltas.
Maria H: Filed PERF-1428 "Selector: immediate kv_hit feature + retrain for burst resilience" and linked dumps and traces.
Lee R: Also add a short runbook note to #eng-runtime about the interaction: batch-token budget tweaks can amplify impact of KV priming evictions.
Maria H: Will add runbook snippet and a grafana panel for kernel-misroute rate by cohort.
Simon T: Let's keep canary at 10% and monitor 24h. If we see repeated KV miss spikes, escalate to rollback.
perf-bot: note: monitor window set 24h for canary cohort
Maria H: Thanks all. I'll post another status in ~30m with updated p95/p99 and KV stats.
Lee R: Thx — ping me if it creeps back up.
Simon T: Thanks team :thumbsup:
